QUOTE: `library/error.c` is generated. Its header says so, and `scripts/generate_errors.pl` writes it from: - the template `scripts/data_files/error.fmt` - every `include/mbedtls/*.h` that contains `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_... -0x...`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as the template.
